sentences.text: Shri Rahul Sharma, learned counsel for appellants.

Shri Nitin Gupta, learned Public Prosecutor for the r Heard on I.A. No.6472/2025, which is third application under Section 430 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita/ Section 389 (1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant No.1-Ramjee Lodhi.
Earlier applications were dismissed as withdrawn.

This appeal is filed by the appellants being aggrieved of the judgment dated 22/12/2020 passed by learned Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, Narsinghpur in SCATR No.7026/2018 whereby appellant No.1- Ramjee Lodhi has been convicted for offences punishable under Sections 450, 342, 376(D) of the IPC and has been sentenced to undergo RI for five years along with fine of Rs.500/- with default stipulation of two months RI, RI for six months along with fine of Rs.250/-
with default stipulation of one month RI and twenty years RI along with fine of Rs.3,000/- with default stipulation for two years respectively.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellants that appellant No.1- Ramjee Lodhi is innocent.
Prosecutrix is habitual of making complainants and extracting money.

entities.text: Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, Narsinghpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: She has admitted in her cross-examination that she had earlier made complaints against different persons though she has denied making a 2 CRA-111-2021 compromise after accepting money.
This is third or fourth instance on behalf of the prosecutrix of lodging report of violation of privacy.
Appellant No.1-Ramjee Lodhi is a young man and he has been falsely implicated in the case.
There are good chances of success.
This appeal will take time for its final disposal.
Therefore it is prayed that sentence of the appellant No.1-Ramjee Lodhi be suspended and he be released on bail.
Shri Nitin Gupta, learned Public Prosecutor, on the other hand, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and without commenting on merits, I.A. No.6472/2025 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court on 20.08.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant No.1-Ramjee Lodhi shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
Accordingly, I.A. No.6472/2025 is allowed and disposed of.
C.C. as per rules.
